```yaml
name: Contributor Actions

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Check for changes
      id: check_changes
      run: |
        git diff --cached --name-only > changed_files.txt
        if [ -s changed_files.txt ]; then
          echo "::set-output name=has_changes::true"
        else
          echo "::set-output name=has_changes::false"
        fi

    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v1
      if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella
        fail_ci_if_error: true

    - name: Notify contributors on PR merge
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'closed' && github.event.pull_request.merged == true
      run: |
        echo "PR merged! Thank you, @${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}!"
        # Add more notification logic here as needed
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file includes steps for checking out the repository, setting up Node.js, installing dependencies, running tests, checking for changes, uploading coverage to Codecov, and notifying contributors when a PR is merged. The workflow handles both `push` and `pull_request` events on the `main` branch.
